notes.title: April 9th Update!
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Monitor mode.  To play on your monitor, right-click Apollo 11 VR and choose "Launch on Monitor".
[*]Added comfort warning message, advising teleport as the means of locomotion if new to VR or otherwise sensitive to motion.
[*]Numerous minor cosmetic adjustments throughout experience.
[*]Additional optimizations for comfortable subtitle reading.
[*]Player may now teleport a certain ways into the distance if they are not looking directly at the ground. 
[*]The mirrored view of "Neil's first step" section now has headtracking.
[*]Updated credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Before You Purchase
notes.content:
This is a VR ( Virtual Reality ) Experience. [strike]To play this you will need an Oculus Rift CV1 / DK2 or a HTC Vive[/strike]  You [b]should[/b] play this using an Oculus Rift CV1 / DK2 or an HTC Vive for the best experience.

[strike]Desktop is not supported at this time. It will run desktop but you will have no control over the camera view or be able to select any of the options.[/strike]

[strike][b]Update:[/b] Desktop version will be available soon. Due to the high demand from people asking for a desktop version we will release an update that is desktop enabled very soon. [/strike]

[b]Update #2:[/b] Monitor mode is now available!  To play this on your monitor, ensure your install is up to date and right-click Apollo 11 VR and choose "Launch on Monitor". 

---

Also we are getting a lot of requests about Steam / Oculus keys if I purchase one do I need to re-purchase on the other platform. We would like to make sure that you only need one purchase to play on PC so please let us look into this and get some clarification before we make any promises.

We of course don't expect you to pay twice for the same experience if we can help it so we will do everything we can to ensure that we get an answer to this as soon as we can.
